description:
Simple one-way folder mirroring utility for Windows.

FolderMirror is a lightweight Windows utility for one-way folder mirroring. It supports multiple folder pairs, initial synchronization, system tray operation, startup with Windows, drag-and-drop, and import/export of mirror configurations.
- Prevents multiple FolderMirror instances from running at the same time.
- Launching FolderMirror again now restores the existing window from the system tray.
- Minor stability improvements.
